cues.en: Hey. What's up guys? And welcome back.
cues.zh: 嗨，大家好，欢迎回来。

cues.en: What you just watched was a real time internal combustion engine simulation that I've been working on for the past few months.
cues.zh: 刚才大家看到的是一个实时的内燃机模拟，这是我过去几个月一直在做的项目。

cues.en: Now I've always been pretty disappointed with the quality of car engine sounds in games. And when I used to play PlayStation two back in the day and knew absolutely nothing about programming,
cues.zh: 一直以来，我对游戏中汽车发动机音效的质量都挺失望的。以前我玩 PlayStation 2 的时候，对编程一窍不通，

cues.en: I often wondered why it wasn't possible to just realistically simulate the entire engine.
cues.zh: 我经常纳闷，为什么就不能真实地模拟整个发动机呢？

cues.en: Well, I figured that it was finally time to answer this question for myself.
cues.zh: 好吧，我觉得现在是时候亲自解答这个问题了。

cues.en: So here's a prime example of one of these bad car engine sounds.
cues.zh: 这就是那些糟糕的汽车音效的典型例子。

cues.en: Now I know that most of these are optimized for performance,
cues.zh: 我当然知道，大多数音效都是为了性能进行了优化的，

cues.en: so I don't expect them to be perfect. But I still think that they can be improved.
cues.zh: 所以我并不指望它们完美无缺。但我依然觉得它们有改进的空间。

cues.en: But what exactly makes it bad in the first place?
cues.zh: 不过，究竟是什么让这些音效一开始听起来就很糟呢？

cues.en: Well, first of all, engines sound different under different conditions. So for example, an engine is gonna sound different when it's idling compared to when it's under heavy load or when it's decelerating,
cues.zh: 首先，发动机在不同工况下的声音是不同的。比如，发动机在怠速时的声音，和它在高负载或减速时的声音是不一样的，

cues.en: and and I feel like this is often overlooked in a lot of these games.
cues.zh: 我觉得很多游戏往往忽略了这一点。

cues.en: Engines also have nonlinear
cues.zh: 发动机还具有非线性的

cues.en: response characteristics,
cues.zh: 响应特征，

cues.en: and what I mean by this is that the gas pedal does not dictate a speed to the engine like it might in the case of electric motors. It simply opens some throttle plates and allows the engine to freely choose its own speed, and this is obviously regulated
cues.zh: 我的意思是，油门踏板并不是像电动机那样直接控制发动机的转速。它只是打开一些节气门，让发动机自由决定转速，而这显然是受

cues.en: by how much air is going into the engine. In real life, this looks kind of like this.
cues.zh: 进入发动机的进气量控制的。在现实生活中，情况大概是这样的。

cues.en: Notice how the engine might take some time to react to that input and there are a lot of complex factors that give every engine sort of a unique character.
cues.zh: 注意，引擎对这种输入的反应可能需要一些时间，而且有很多复杂因素让每个引擎都有独特的个性。

cues.en: My goal with this project was to replicate all of this complexity in digital form and create a virtual engine that I can interact with in real time.
cues.zh: 我这个项目的目标是以数字形式复刻所有这些复杂性，创建一个可以实时交互的虚拟引擎。

cues.en: So let me explain how this works.
cues.zh: 那我来解释一下这是怎么运作的。

cues.en: So the first thing is a rigid body simulator simulates all of the interactions between the internal components like the crankshaft and connecting rods and pistons.
cues.zh: 首先是刚体模拟器，它模拟曲轴、连杆和活塞等内部组件之间的所有相互作用。

cues.en: Usually, this is called your rotating assembly.
cues.zh: 这通常被称为旋转组件。

cues.en: I wrote this physics engine a few months ago, and I made a video about it if you're interested.
cues.zh: 这个物理引擎是我几个月前写的，如果你感兴趣的话，我做过一期相关视频。

cues.en: Now I wanna emphasize that this is not some sort of visualization.
cues.zh: 我想强调一下，这可不是什么可视化演示。

cues.en: This is totally legit. It is a rigid body simulation.
cues.zh: 这是完全真实的。这是一个刚体模拟。

cues.en: And just to prove it, I can remove some of the links and all of a sudden we have whatever this is.
cues.zh: 为了证明这一点，我可以移除一些连接件，然后突然就变成了这个样子。

cues.en: So in other words, all of the forces between the links including things like inertia and even the sliding friction between the cylinder walls and the pistons are taken into consideration in this simulation.
cues.zh: 换句话说，连接件之间的所有力，包括惯性，甚至气缸壁与活塞之间的滑动摩擦，都在这个模拟中得到了考虑。

cues.en: I also implemented a physically realistic fluid simulation to handle the airflow between the cylinders and the other parts of the engine.
cues.zh: 我还实现了一个物理上逼真的流体模拟，来处理气缸与引擎其他部分之间的气流。

cues.en: I try to take as few shortcuts as possible,
cues.zh: 我尽量少走捷径，

cues.en: so there aren't really any tricks or shenanigans here. The air molecules and the bulk velocity of that air is simulated in a realistic way as it travels through the engine, and a physically accurate amount of energy is released when that fuel is burned.
cues.zh: 所以这里没有什么花招或猫腻。空气分子和空气的整体速度在流经引擎时是以逼真的方式模拟的，燃料燃烧时释放的能量在物理上也是准确的。

cues.en: Even the speed of the flame propagation in the cylinder is very accurately simulated.
cues.zh: 连气缸内火焰传播的速度都能非常精确地模拟出来。

cues.en: This entire simulation, by the way, has to run at around 80,000 frames per second to remain stable, so it had to be heavily optimized.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，整个模拟必须以大约每秒 80,000 帧的速度运行才能保持稳定，所以它必须经过大量优化。

cues.en: And I'll show you what happens if it runs any slower.
cues.zh: 我来展示一下如果运行得再慢一点会发生什么。

cues.en: Basically, your engine just grenades into the fourth dimension immediately.
cues.zh: 基本上，你的发动机立刻就会炸进第四维。

cues.en: The pressure wave that is created in the exhaust system is sent directly to a separate thread that then converts it into an audio signal.
cues.zh: 排气系统中产生的压力波会直接送到一个单独的线程，再由它转换成音频信号。

cues.en: The final audio signal consists of some plain white noise, a little bit of equalization,
cues.zh: 最终的音频信号由一些纯白噪声、一点均衡处理，

cues.en: and a filter which approximates
cues.zh: 以及一个滤波器组成，这个滤波器近似

cues.en: the sound propagation pattern within the exhaust system.
cues.zh: 排气系统内的声音传播模式。

cues.en: So here's a demonstration starting with the base pressure wave which kinda sounds a little bit uninteresting.
cues.zh: 下面做个演示，从基础压力波开始，听起来有点乏味。

cues.en: And once all of the added processing is there, you can see that it sounds a little bit more familiar.
cues.zh: 等所有附加处理都加上之后，你可以看到它听起来就有点耳熟了。

cues.en: The simulation is actually so accurate that it can predict horsepower curves given a set of engine specifications
cues.zh: 这个模拟实际上精确到可以根据一组发动机规格预测马力曲线

cues.en: usually to within 10%.
cues.zh: 通常误差在 10% 以内。

cues.en: And I'll show you how that works in a minute.
cues.zh: 我马上会演示这是怎么做到的。

cues.en: These engine specifications
cues.zh: 这些发动机规格

cues.en: are defined in a Piranha script where you can connect multiple individual components together to form a complete engine.
cues.zh: 是在 Piranha 脚本中定义的，你可以把多个独立组件连接在一起，组成一台完整的发动机。

cues.en: Piranha is my own custom scripting language that I made and I use it on some of my other projects as well. You can learn about it in my other videos on my channel.
cues.zh: Piranha 是我自己做的自定义脚本语言，我也在其他一些项目里用它。你可以在我的频道上其他视频里了解它。

cues.en: Alright. So let's see a basic demonstration.
cues.zh: 好的，我们来看一个基本演示。

cues.en: We can start with a stock engine that you might find in a nineteen seventies truck. Specifically, this is a four fifty four, which stands for 454
cues.zh: 我们可以从一款老式发动机开始，比如上世纪七十年代卡车上的那种。具体来说，这是一台454，代表454

cues.en: cubic inches or 7.4
cues.zh: 立方英寸，也就是7.4

cues.en: liters.
cues.zh: 升。

cues.en: I've actually built one of these myself so I know quite a bit about them. All the parameters that I put into the simulation are taken from real world data.
cues.zh: 我自己其实造过一台这样的发动机，所以对它相当了解。我在仿真中输入的所有参数都来自真实世界的数据。

cues.en: Alright. First, we'll press a to turn the ignition on, and then we'll press s to engage the starter just like in a real engine.
cues.zh: 好，首先我们按a打开点火开关，然后按s启动起动机，就像真实发动机一样。

cues.en: By pressing various keys on the keyboard, I can open or close the throttle, which of course causes the engine to change speeds.
cues.zh: 通过按键盘上的不同按键，我可以打开或关闭节气门，这当然会让发动机转速发生变化。

cues.en: By pressing the d key, I can enable the dynamometer,
cues.zh: 按d键，我可以启用测功机，

cues.en: so we can measure the torque and horsepower of this engine.
cues.zh: 这样我们就能测量这台发动机的扭矩和马力。

cues.en: If we look up the original figures given by GM in 1974,
cues.zh: 如果我们查一下1974年通用汽车给出的原始数据，

cues.en: we can see that they are very close to the predicted values in the simulation.
cues.zh: 可以看到它们与仿真中的预测值非常接近。

cues.en: Even the curves are roughly the same shape with both peak torque and peak power happening at roughly the same engine speed.
cues.zh: 甚至曲线形状也大致相同，峰值扭矩和峰值功率都出现在大致相同的发动机转速下。

cues.en: Now by just changing the parts in the engine, you can actually change the way that it sounds. So if I put in some high performance parts in a camshaft with a slightly different lobe profile,
cues.zh: 现在，只要更换发动机里的零件，你其实就能改变它的声音。所以如果我换上一些高性能零件，比如凸轮轴轮廓稍有不同，

cues.en: you can see that the engine both produces more power, but also sounds noticeably different.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，发动机不仅输出更大功率，声音也明显不同。

cues.en: I did not change any of the audio synthesis settings. This is based only on the internal components of the engine.
cues.zh: 我没有改动任何音频合成设置。这完全基于发动机的内部组件。

cues.en: To get a better feeling for the power of the engine, I also implemented this vehicle simulation
cues.zh: 为了更好地感受这个引擎的强大之处，我还实现了这个车辆模拟

cues.en: with a clutch transmission and drivetrain simulation.
cues.zh: 包含离合器变速箱和传动系统的模拟。

cues.en: It also approximates the rolling resistance of the vehicle as well as air resistance.
cues.zh: 它还近似计算了车辆的滚动阻力以及空气阻力。

cues.en: In my opinion, the biggest improvement over many of the models that I've seen is the engine braking sound which sounds really good. So engine braking or overrunning is when you run the engine faster than it should be given the throttle position
cues.zh: 在我看来，与我见过的许多模型相比，最大的改进是引擎制动音效，听起来真的很棒。所谓引擎制动或超速运转，就是当你让引擎转速高于节气门位置所对应的应有转速时

cues.en: which produces a sort of braking effect and you can kind of think of it as like negative horsepower.
cues.zh: 会产生一种制动效果，你可以把它想象成负马力。

cues.en: And this also noticeably changes the tone of the engine.
cues.zh: 这也会明显改变引擎的音调。

cues.en: So far in this video, I've only shown v eight engines, but that's not the only thing that this simulator can do. It's actually completely generic. So
cues.zh: 到目前为止，在这个视频里我只展示了V8引擎，但这并不是这个模拟器唯一能做的事。它实际上是完全通用的。所以

cues.en: you could simulate a v six, an inline four. You can even simulate non
cues.zh: 你可以模拟V6、直列四缸。你甚至可以模拟非

cues.en: standard engine configurations like a v three
cues.zh: 标准的引擎配置，比如V3

cues.en: or you could even have six cylinders on one side and four on the other. It doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 或者甚至可以一侧六个气缸、另一侧四个。都无所谓。

cues.en: It can handle pretty much anything. So if you have any ideas for specific engines that you want me to test, please write them in the comments and I'll definitely be making a follow-up video to this.
cues.zh: 它几乎能处理任何情况。所以如果你有想让我测试的特定引擎的想法，请在评论中写出来，我一定会制作这个视频的后续。

cues.en: Just to prove that it actually does work, I entered the parameters of this Kohler v twin engine and you typically find these things on sawmills or wood chippers and other industrial equipment.
cues.zh: 为了证明它确实有效，我输入了这台Kohler V型双缸引擎的参数，你通常会在锯木厂或木材削片机以及其他工业设备上看到这些东西。

cues.en: I'm very familiar with this particular engine in real life and I can confirm
cues.zh: 我对现实中的这款发动机非常熟悉，我可以确认

cues.en: that the simulation produces a very accurate replication of the sound
cues.zh: 这个模拟对声音的还原非常精准

cues.en: and the horsepower figures are pretty much exactly the same as in real life.
cues.zh: 马力数据也和现实中几乎完全一致。

cues.en: Now as much as I would have liked to discuss all of the technical details of this project, there would have been just way too much to cover in a single video.
cues.zh: 虽然我很想详细聊聊这个项目的所有技术细节，但一个视频里实在装不下那么多内容。

cues.en: I literally read entire textbooks
cues.zh: 我 literally 读完了整本教科书

cues.en: while researching this, and I've also read a lot of research papers.
cues.zh: 在做这个研究的时候，我还读了很多研究论文。

cues.en: I genuinely have no idea if anyone would even be interested in these details,
cues.zh: 我真的不知道会不会有人对这些细节感兴趣，

cues.en: so please let me know if you are.
cues.zh: 所以如果你感兴趣的话请告诉我。

cues.en: Also, at the time of releasing this video, the code is open source on my GitHub, so check it out if you're interested. The link to that is in the description.
cues.zh: 另外，在这个视频发布的时候，代码已经开源在我的 GitHub 上了，感兴趣的话可以去看看。链接在简介里。

cues.en: I hope you guys liked the video, and thanks for watching.
cues.zh: 希望你们喜欢这个视频，感谢观看。
